record.one_liner: Front is a customer communication platform that combines email, SMS, chat and social channels into shared inboxes with team collaboration and workflow automation.
record.auth_notes: Core API uses Bearer tokens, obtained either as company-level API tokens (generated in Front settings by an admin) or via OAuth (required for public integrations unless Front grants an exception). The MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, scopes read/write/send, no Dynamic Client Registration, per-user tokens.
record.access_notes: Creating API tokens requires an admin. A 14-day no-credit-card trial (Professional-level features) is offered per the pricing page. Paid plans: Starter $25, Professional $65, Enterprise $105 per seat/month (annual billing). No free tier found. The docs I fetched do not state which plan is the minimum for API access. The pricing page's rate-limit add-on listing suggests Starter includes the API, but that is my inference, not verified. Developer apps are created under Settings > Company > Developer.
record.blocker: No free tier (trial or paid seat needed). Token creation requires a Front admin. The rate limit is per company, not per token: 50/100/200 requests per minute on Starter/Professional/Enterprise. The MCP server needs a client ID and secret because DCR is unsupported, and its release status (beta or GA) is unclear from the docs. The docs call the API a "Core API" and do not use the word REST, so REST is inferred from the HTTP/JSON description.
